benefits.name: 5X on Flights
benefits.description: Earn 5 points per $1 on flights booked directly with airlines or through AmexTravel.com.

benefits.name: 5X on Hotels
benefits.description: Earn 5 points per $1 on prepaid hotels booked through AmexTravel.com.

benefits.name: 1X Base Rate
benefits.description: Earn 1 point per $1 on all other eligible purchases.

benefits.name: $200 Airline Fee Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 per calendar year in statement credits for incidental fees at one selected qualifying airline.

benefits.name: $200 Hotel Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 per year in statement credits for prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection bookings through AmexTravel.com.

benefits.name: $15 Uber Cash
benefits.description: Up to $15 per month in Uber Cash for Uber rides or Uber Eats ($35 in December).

benefits.name: $20 Digital Entertainment Credit
benefits.description: Up to $20 per month in statement credits for eligible digital entertainment subscriptions (Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, NYT, Audible, Peacock, SiriusXM).

benefits.name: Centurion Lounge Access
benefits.description: Complimentary access to The Centurion Lounge network and Priority Pass Select lounges worldwide.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.description: Up to $100 statement credit for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee every 4.5 years.
